summary: AGM Group Holdings filed a Form 6-K disclosing a September 17, 2026 share purchase agreement with an unnamed investor for a Regulation S private placement of Class A ordinary shares at US$0.6305 per share, targeting up to US$11.0 million in gross proceeds. No stake percentage, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing date is disclosed beyond the price-adjustment mechanism. This is an ordinary exempt capital-raising takedown, not a special situation; no tender, tender-offer, or change-of-control element exists. Watch for dilution from the new shares and any price-reset under Section 3.2.
